items.name: Astana Cubing Rush 2026
items.information:
Қазақша:

Astana Cubing Rush 2026 – Астана қаласында өтетін ресми жарыс.

Барлық іс-шараға қатысу үшін негізгі құны – 3000 теңге.
Жарыстың басты дисциплинасы – 3х3.

English:

Astana Cubing Rush 2026 – an official tournament held in Astana.

The basic participation fee for all events is 3000 tenge.
The main discipline of the competition is 3x3.

items.information:
You don't have to do other things, Just Cube and Go!

# **IMPORTANT REMINDER**
Although this is a free competition, you still need to secure your slot by paying a "securing fee" which costs Php 300.00. To refund the payment, you MUST attend the competition. Just approach Kuya Xavier, the organizer, for the refund. Failing to attend the competition may open slots for walk-ins.

​
The **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** (NSOC) presents **La Carlota Speedcubing Open 2026**.
​
* All the necessary information can be found in the tabs above.
* If you are interested in participating, the full registration details can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaCarlotaSpeedcubingOpen2026#83597-payment-and-registration).
* Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating.
* Please take note that the schedule given is not fixed and may run ahead or behind depending on the competition flow that day. Please stay updated and be ready for any adjustments. We also recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before your event to avoid missing it.
​
###### *By participating in this event, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.*

items.information:
## Note: This competition does not feature the 3x3x3 Cube event.
Welcome to Penang Niche DUAL 2026! This competition only features 3x3x3 One-Handed, Skewb, Clock and Square-1.

[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/PenangNicheDual2026)

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the Updates & Announcements and the New Competitors tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

Competitors should ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.

*Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.*

items.name: Raipur Winter Cube Open 2026
items.information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.**
There will be no On-the-spot (OTS) registration.The fees structure is as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab] https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurWinterCubeOpen2026#83718-registrations-payments

Please note once you register on the WCA site for this competition, 
your name will 1st be in the waiting list.
Only once your payment is completed, your name will show up within 48hrs.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New-comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they will have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, 
organisers will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and overall participation.
We will be dividing all the participants into groups and will be giving you a time slot during which one and come and particpate in all events and all this information will be send to you through email once we finish all the registration.

Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.

items.name: Veni Vidi Vellmar 2026
items.information:
Wir laden euch ein zu zwei Tagen Cubing in Vellmar samt Aftercomp mit gemeinsamen Essen, Brettspielen, Dart, Kreuzworträtseln und worauf ihr noch lust habt.

We invite you to two days of cubing in Vellmar paired with some aftercomp activities like dinner, boardgames, darts, cross-word puzzle and anything else you would like to do.
